admin_by_request_raw.dataset_description: Admin By Request is a privileged access management (PAM) solution that grants users temporary local admin rights.

application.field_description: The application involved in the Admin By Request event.

computer.field_description: The computer the elevation request was made from.

auditLogURL.field_description: The URL of the Admin By Request audit log entry related to the event.

source_log_type.field_description: The event type of the Admin By Request record.

type.field_description: The type of elevation request made in Admin By Request.

user.field_description: The user associated with the elevation request.

computerName.field_description: The name of the computer on which the Admin By Request event occurred.

eventLevel.field_description: The numeric severity level of the Admin By Request event.

additionalData.field_description: Additional details that Admin By Request provides about the event.

userAccount.field_description: The account name of the user associated with the Admin By Request event.

userName.field_description: The user name of the user who initiated the Admin By Request event.

reason.field_description: The reason the user gave when requesting elevated admin rights.

eventText.field_description: The message text describing the Admin By Request event.

auditlogLink.field_description: The link to the Admin By Request portal audit log entry for the request.

approvedBy.field_description: The name of the user who approved the elevation request.

approvedByEmail.field_description: The email address of the user who approved the elevation request.

deniedBy.field_description: The name of the user who denied the elevation request.

deniedByEmail.field_description: The email address of the user who denied the elevation request.

deniedReason.field_description: The reason given for denying the elevation request.
